participation.context: Named the hour, the fourth act, and the old Roman, and left Verona at home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set one play, and said the Rose bill was their afternoon.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Kept the roll, and refused Verona in the Roman plot.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Asked where his cue sits, and reported the bill he had read on a post.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

relations.note: Thomas comes in on his own cue
relations.quote: Do not borrow his death to find it.

story.body: You named two of the clock and the fourth act. Abel kept the roll. Thomas kept his own cue and reported the one Rose title. John said he would tell the hired men the same.

relations.note: Thomas comes in on his own cue
relations.quote: Do not borrow his death to find it.

title: Set Titus at two and the death in the fourth act

participation.context: Spoke in the passage after his death in the play, and stayed off.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You were already dead in the play. You did not return for the fifth. You left it at that.

title: Came off in the fourth act
